verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM lets users decide where data lives through its own documented deployment modes. The desktop app keeps documents on-device, and the team product can be self-hosted on your own infrastructure or deployed on-premise, so the user picks the storage location. However, nothing documents region or residency selection for the vendor-hosted plan, and no residency guarantees or compliance statements are given. Missing for 10: region selection for the hosted offering, explicit data-residency documentation or guarantees, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
